final: WITH budget_with_event AS (SELECT b.*, e.status FROM budget b JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id), event_level AS (SELECT link_to_event, status, AVG(remaining) as event_avg_remaining, AVG(CASE WHEN amount != 0 THEN (spent - amount) / CAST(amount AS REAL) ELSE NULL END) as event_avg_overspend_rate FROM budget_with_event GROUP BY link_to_event, status), status_level AS (SELECT status, AVG(event_avg_remaining) as status_avg_remaining, AVG(event_avg_overspend_rate) as status_avg_overspend_rate FROM event_level GROUP BY status), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(event_avg_remaining) as overall_avg_remaining FROM event_level) SELECT s.status, s.status_avg_remaining, s.status_avg_overspend_rate, s.status_avg_remaining / o.overall_avg_remaining as remaining_ratio FROM status_level s CROSS JOIN overall_avg o
